news.title: O’Neill School faculty lead new undergraduate research initiative
news.summary_en: O’Neill professors André Franco and Kim Novick join IU’s Layered-Learning Program to study climate change impacts on forest ecosystems and mentor undergraduate researchers.

news.title: O’Neill School alumnus appointed to lead IU national security initiatives, serve as executive-in-residence
news.summary_en: Brett Seidle named IU’s chief advisor for national security research and development and executive-in-residence at O’Neill, strengthening research and student leadership development.

news.title: Fantoni honored with pair of best dissertation awards
news.summary_en: O’Neill Ph.D. alum Marylis Fantoni earned national dissertation awards for research on improving domestic violence reporting and public services for survivors.

news.title: O'Neill study shows solar expansion won't threaten food cost or security
news.summary_en: New O’Neill School research finds utility-scale solar expansion on farmland is unlikely to significantly affect U.S. crop production or food prices.
